component.name: Leotheca
component.summary: A free and open source markdown viewer and editor

description.p: Leotheca is a free and open source markdown viewer and editor for a local folder of plain text notes. No account, no telemetry, no proprietary sync service. Point it at any folder of markdown files and use whatever folder sync tool you already trust to keep it in sync across devices.

ul.li: File tree with create, rename, and delete (to a trash folder, not gone for good)
Tabs with autosave and session restore
Source, Split, and Preview editing modes with syntax highlighting and rendered Markdown
[[wikilinks]] with autocomplete, backlinks, and a pannable graph view
Bookmarks, a command palette, and full-text search
A light and dark theme that follows your OS by default

screenshot.caption: Split view: source and rendered preview side by side, with wikilinks and backlinks
The graph view, showing how notes connect via wikilinks
Settings: theme, font size, zoom, workspace statistics, and keyboard shortcuts

description.p: Initial release: local folder workspace, wikilinks with backlinks and a graph view, bookmarks, command palette, full-text search, and a light/dark theme.
